evidence.description: Private key /home/deployer/.ssh/id_rsa accessed by unexpected web process on CI-RUNNER-01
Successful SSH login to DB-POSTGRES-01 using deployer key from DMZ web host 10.0.1.77
Interactive bash session spawned on database host immediately dumping tables (host: CI-RUNNER-01)

findings.description: Detected: Stolen private SSH key utilized to pivot laterally from DMZ web server to production database server.
Detected: Database dump command executed immediately upon session establishment.

output.rationale: Evaluation of competing hypotheses: While administrative maintenance was considered, the presence of unauthorized artifacts refutes benign operational intent. Specifically, Confirmed multi-host lateral pivot utilizing harvested SSH credentials to access backend database tier.

recommended_actions.action: Revoke SSH public key across all servers in authorized_keys files immediately.
Isolate both DMZ pivot server and DB-POSTGRES-01.

alert.title: Anomalous Proxy User-Agent String Logged with Truncated IP (employee10) [ALT-16833]

evidence.description: Outbound web request with anomalous user-agent 'Mozilla/4.0 (compatible)' recorded by edge proxy on HR-PC-005
User employee01 authenticated to proxy within same minute

findings.description: Anomalous legacy User-Agent string detected, but upstream proxy failure lost destination IP and URL.

output.rationale: Corroborating indicators across endpoint and perimeter data sources establish that anomalous User-Agent could represent custom C2 or legacy software check, but missing destination leaves assessment inconclusive.

recommended_actions.action: Correlate workstation local web browser cache and netstat connection history for timestamp window.

alert.title: Routine Temp Cleanup Script Executed by SYSTEM on SRV-BACKUP-01 (ALT-79998)

evidence.description: Scheduled Task 'WeeklyTempCleanup' triggered on schedule on SRV-BACKUP-01
powershell.exe deleted 142 expired log files from C:\Windows\Temp (host: SRV-BACKUP-01)

findings.description: Detected: Built-in scheduled task performed routine temporary file cleanup.

output.rationale: Operational baseline assessment: Activity was evaluated for potential unauthorized abuse. Verified parameters and identity context corroborate legitimate administrative execution: Expected automated maintenance action executed by SYSTEM account according to documented schedule.

recommended_actions.action: No action required. Routine maintenance.

alert.title: Security Detection ALT-97996: Registry Run Key Directing to VBScript in User Profile

evidence.description: HKCU\...\Run key 'WindowsUpdateHelper' created pointing to update.vbs on PC-042
Obfuscated script update.vbs written to Roaming directory

findings.description: Detected: Masqueraded registry persistence key established pointing to script in writeable user directory.

output.rationale: Evaluation of competing hypotheses: While administrative maintenance was considered, the presence of unauthorized artifacts refutes benign operational intent. Specifically, Use of deceptive key name and VBScript located in AppData is a classic userland persistence technique.

recommended_actions.action: Delete registry key 'WindowsUpdateHelper' and quarantine update.vbs.
